This indicates that Loxapine may influence Drd5 through a common pathway involving G-protein signaling. The scores from the two paths, while slightly different, both point to a shared mechanism of action involving receptor activation and subsequent downstream effects on Drd5. The integration of these pathways supports a mechanistic link between Loxapine and Drd5, particularly in the context of G-protein coupled receptor activity.
